name: glaze-fix
description: Dependencies for the glaze fork's FIX work: tests, benchmarks, tag-lookup probes and the Orchestra generator. Glaze itself is header-only and needs none.

tests.description: Optional libraries glaze's own tests find with find_package (networking, SSL, SQLite)

lookup.description: Tag-lookup libraries compared in the layout probes

orchestra.description: FIX Orchestra XML reading for the code generator. On the gcc16 triplets reflect-cpp is built with its C++26 reflection backend (see triplets/arm64-osx-gcc16.cmake).
